source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 26 марта ст. ст. — «Мчч. Вафусия и Верка пресвитеров, Арпилы монаха; мирян: Авива, Агна, Реаса, Игафракса, Искоя, Силы, Сигица, Сонирила, Суимвла, Ферма, Филла и мцц. Анны, Аллы, Ларисы, Моико, Мамики, Уирко, Анимаисы (Анимаиды), Гаафы, царицы Готфской, и Дуклиды, царевны Готфской (ок. 375)»

attestations.note: The Russian calendar keeps the company on the same menologion day as the Romanian and the Greek, and unlike either of them it enumerates: the day line names twenty-three of them and gives every one of the twenty-three its own name page. The company was NOT divided into folders here, and the reason is in the life below: the source counts them three ways — twenty-three on the day line, twenty-five in the title of its own shared life, and twenty-one names said to be known out of three hundred and eight who died — and two of its own readings disagree about which of the women was the Gothic queen. One folder per enumerated member is the standing ruling, but this folder already carries venerated Romanian and Greek rows for the same company and a life that names twenty-one of them, so applying the ruling here would hold one company twice over; the division is the author's to make, and the twenty-three names and their disagreements are set down in the life so that nothing has to be fetched again. The line dates them «ок. 375», inside the 375–383 this folder already holds. Two of the women, «Алла» and «Лариса», have a separate life of their own behind their name pages. The day page's three hymns are all the Archangel Gabriel's. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 26 martie — «Sfinții 26 de Mucenici din Goția/Dacia»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 26ης Μαρτίου — «Άγιοι Είκοσι Έξι Μάρτυρες οι εν Γοτθία μαρτυρήσαντες»

attestations.note: Unlike doxologia.ro, saint.gr names all twenty-six, twice over: once in its list of the saints commemorated and again in a closing paragraph that sorts them into two presbyters with the two sons and three daughters of one of them, a monk, eleven laymen and seven women, and offers a variant spelling for nine of the names. The two lists agree with each other and with the number. The page puts the martyrdom «μεταξύ των ετών 375 - 383 μ.Χ.», under the Gothic king Iungourichos and the emperor Gratian, and gives no hymn. Whether an enumerated company of twenty-six should be twenty-six folders under `docs/CORPUS.md` §10.1 is not a reader's decision and is left open; this row records the Greek day on the one folder that exists.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Το μαρτύριό τους συνέβη μεταξύ των ετών 375 - 383 μ.Χ.», and it puts them «κατά τους χρόνους του βασιλέως των Γότθων Ιουγγουρίχου και του αυτοκράτορα Γρατιανού (375 - 383 μ.Χ.)» — the years the page gives are the reign it names, not a year of death.
